address.title: Address
address.description: Redis server address as a URL: `redis://` or `rediss://` (TLS) for TCP, `unix://` for a Unix socket.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Connection and read/write timeout, in seconds.

username.title: Username
username.description: Username for authentication. A username in the address takes precedence.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password for authentication. A password in the address takes precedence.

tls_skip_verify.title: Skip TLS verification
tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate and hostname verification. Insecure.

tls_ca.title: TLS CA
tls_ca.description: Path to a CA bundle used to verify the server certificate. Leave empty to use the system trust store.

tls_cert.title: TLS client certificate
tls_cert.description: Path to a client certificate file for mutual TLS. Requires a client key.

tls_key.title: TLS client key
tls_key.description: Path to the client key file for mutual TLS. Requires a client certificate.

autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: How often to retry the initial connection when the job fails to start, in seconds. Zero disables retries.

ping_samples.title: Ping samples
ping_samples.description: Number of PING commands sent each data collection interval to measure latency.

functions.title: Functions
functions.description: Settings of the interactive Functions this job exposes in the UI.

top_queries.title: Top Queries
top_queries.description: Settings of the Top Queries function, which lists the slowest recent commands from the Redis slow log.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Query timeout, in seconds. Zero uses the collector timeout.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of slow log entries to return. Zero uses the default (500).

address.ui:help:
TCP connection: `redis://user:password@host:port/db`. TLS: `rediss://user:password@host:port/db`. Unix socket: `unix://user:password@/path/to/redis.sock?db=0`.

Setting any TLS option also enables TLS for a `redis://` address.

timeout.ui:help: Accepts decimals for precise control (e.g., type 1.5 for 1.5 seconds).

vnode.ui:help: Charts of this job appear under the Virtual Node instead of this host. Define the Virtual Node in `vnodes.conf` first, then enter its name here.

top_queries.ui:help: Command arguments in the results may contain unmasked literals, including personal data.
